source: APPP / MAFF-JICA — Rice Seed Production Manual (សៀវភៅមគ្គទេសក៍ផលិតកម្មពូជស្រូវ), 2014, Agricultural Productivity Promotion Project in West Tonle Sap, p.46
text: As of the 2014 manual, the following farmer seed-production groups, established with APPP/JICA support, were producing registered/certified rice seed and could be a source of quality seed for farmers: Battambang province had three groups — a 'Rice Seed Production' farmer solidarity group in Banan district, one in Moung Ruessei district, and one in Bavel district. Pursat province had one source — the provincial Department of Agriculture's demonstration farm/nursery station. Kampong Chhnang province had one group — a 'Rice Seed Production' farmer solidarity group in Rolea B'ier district. The source document lists named group leaders and personal phone numbers for each group as of 2014; these are omitted here as likely-stale contact details — group leadership and contacts should be reconfirmed with the provincial Department of Agriculture or CARDI before relying on them. The source notes group leadership may change over time and advises confirming current details with the provincial agriculture office.
